title: The Work panel hides P0 items: it sorts by priority only the first 200 rows, loaded oldest first
outcome: The Work panel always shows the highest-priority open items, whatever the project's size and whenever they were created.
acceptance: The fix fails before it and passes after it, with a recorded source-revert run.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.

With more open items than the auto-load target, the Work panel's default view shows every open P0 and P1 item, including active (held) items created after the first auto-loaded rows. A test covers this, with a fixture where a P0 item sorts after the first 200 rows in Engram's default order.
